'''Nerf casserole''' was a [[Casserole/Legends|casserole]] that was derived from the [[Nerf/Legends|nerf]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The taste of the [[Foodstuff/Legends|dish]] could be enhanced by adding dried [[vohis mold]] that, along with [[shvash gas]], was one of the only two commodities exported from the [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gelgelar/Legends|Gelgelar]].<ref name="Platt's" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nerf casserole was mentioned in ''[[Platt's Starport Guide]]'', a sourcebook that was published in [[1995]] as a supplement to the [[West End Games]] campaign guide ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Platt's" />
